title: Source-Route Months on Extension — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Rule.** The extension term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers counts source-route months. These follow the itinerary class, under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand, of the ticket the credit arose from:

(a) 2 months when that ticket was a long-haul international itinerary;
(b) 1 month when it was a short-haul international itinerary;
(c) none when it was domestic.

| Itinerary class of the ticket the credit arose from | Source-route months |
|---|---|
| long-haul international | 2 |
| short-haul international | 1 |
| domestic | none |

**Which ticket.** The credit's source ticket, the ticket the credit arose from.

**Hypothetical application.** A credit that arose from a long-haul international ticket counts 2 source-route months, and one that arose from a domestic ticket counts none.
